AutoAuth._comment: UnlockHash is a salted PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256 digest of the auto-authorisation unlock password. The password itself is NOT in this repository and cannot be recovered from this value. Override per environment with AutoAuth__UnlockHash, and rotate with: dotnet run --project api/tools/HashPassword -- '<new password>'. Set Enabled to false to refuse every auto-authorisation change regardless of password.
